sites.evidence_type: topology inference (C-terminal snorkel — no accessible terminus)
sites.rationale: C-terminus not extracellular (topology 'I' at residue L) and no accessible N-terminus — C-terminal snorkel presents the tag on the surface via a TM-snorkeling linker (fallback: no natively accessible terminus)
ordered surface loop (9 aa): pLDDT>=70, DSSP loop/turn, exposed junction residue (max RSA), indel-tolerant, 3D-clear of features

literature_notes: All three ledger lines originate from the same publication (PMC13386948) and concern the same mCherry-CLDN12 construct. L2 explicitly states the mCherry tag is C-terminal; CLDN12's C-terminus (residue 244) lies in the intracellular region (195–244) per the authoritative topology landmarks, so this is an intracellular fusion, not a surface tag. L3 describes site-directed mutagenesis of palmitoylation cysteines (C3→S, C109→S) — this is not a tag insertion of any kind and does not qualify under any ledger criterion. CLDN12 has two extracellular loops (ECL1: 31–87; ECL2: 153–173) that are topologically accessible, but no ledger line reports any insertion, epitope tag, fluorescent-protein fusion, or transposon hit in either loop or at either extracellular face. Zero surface tag sites are supported.

literature_other_positions.note: mCherry fused to the C-terminus of full-length CLDN12; residue 244 (T) lies in the intracellular region (195–244), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
